name: Cargo Bay
narrativeOnEnter: Stacked containers, magnetic clamps, a loading rail overhead. One section is blocked by a freight security lock — four-position switch, red light blinking. Beyond it, a passage to the reactor deck. A clipboard with a freight manifest hangs on the wall.

hotspots.label: Reactor Deck
hotspots.lockedMessage: Freight security lock is engaged on this passage. The lock switch sequence is on the cargo manifest.

action.text:
MERIDIAN STATION — CARGO MANIFEST
Delivery Ref: MA-7743-C

Freight security lock sequence for this section:
Switch positions must be set HIGH, HIGH, LOW, LOW
(Positions 1–4)

Note from logistics:
'This sequence was changed after the last incident.
Do not reset to default.'

The switches engage a magnetic clamp release on the passage
to Reactor Deck.

Sealed cargo containers, secured with magnetic clamps. Labels read:
'REACTOR COMPONENTS — HANDLE WITH CARE'
'MEDICAL SUPPLIES — COLD STORAGE'
'PERSONAL EFFECTS — CREW ROTATION 7'

One container has a cracked seal. Inside: vacuum-packed ration packs. Probably not useful right now.
